result.guidance: Use connection_id as account_id in account, market and trading tools. Present accounts to the user using broker_identity broker/login/server, never transport IDs as account numbers. Missing identity means it has not been observed. Verify using account_read, which refreshes native identity; a saved connection is not proof of live broker connectivity.

limitations: Measured from broker bars only; forming bars are excluded from every calculation.
Daily and weekly bars follow the broker server's day boundary.
Labels describe measurements, not entry signals or forecasts.
Session hours are conventional local-time FX centre hours, not exchange or broker schedules.
Public holidays, early closes and liquidity are not modelled.
